what_it_wanted_to_adapt.target_expression: Atmospheric perspective with target-owned color hierarchy, preserving warm-cool separation
what_it_wanted_to_adapt.rationale: Source uses teal-green background with warm amber accents to separate planes and create mood. Adapt to museum-appropriate palette while preserving the functional temperature contrast and atmospheric depth.

what_it_wanted_to_adapt.target_expression: Material contrast between warm organic/analog surfaces and cool analytical/structural surfaces
what_it_wanted_to_adapt.rationale: Source contrasts warm stone/wood/gold against cool tile/metal. Adapt to museum materials (brass, glass, paper, stone) that communicate time, matter, and curiosity through tactile opposition.

what_it_wanted_to_adapt.target_expression: Exhibition name, dates, and museum name as integrated display typography following diagonal flow
what_it_wanted_to_adapt.rationale: Source integrates typography into scene geometry and flow. Adapt to target copy needs while preserving the typography-as-environment and directional reading functions.

what_it_wanted_to_reinvent.target_expression: Levitation of science-appropriate artifacts (precision instruments, temporal devices, specimen representations, equations) clustered around hero
what_it_wanted_to_reinvent.rationale: Source object cluster creates wonder and thematic density through surreal levitation. For science museum, replace creative-design props with verified scientific artifacts that represent time, matter, and curiosity while preserving the clustered composition.

what_it_discarded.rationale: Source text is brand-specific Portuguese copy for creative services. It cannot transfer to science museum context and must be replaced with target exhibition copy.

what_it_discarded.target_expression: Source focal prop (mushroom mug) and specific object identities
what_it_discarded.rationale: Mushroom mug is category-specific to creative/psychedelic context and has no place in science museum exhibition. All source objects must be replaced with target-native artifacts.

what_it_discarded.target_expression: Source person identity, wardrobe, and bathroom environment
what_it_discarded.rationale: Source person (Neymar Jr.), denim jacket, and tiled bathroom are identity-specific and category-inappropriate. Target requires no reference person identity and a professional museum context.

what_risks_it_identified: Identity leakage: Source celebrity (Neymar Jr.) may unconsciously influence target subject styling or pose
Category mismatch: Creative-design props (mushrooms, fountain pen, denim) may leak into science context if not actively replaced
Surface copy: Floating object logic may be copied without semantic fit to science theme
Undertransfer: Complexity may be reduced due to perceived risk of dense composition
Overtransfer: Exact composition coordinates or object arrangement may be traced
